summary: Full backend + frontend testing for INFLOW MKT marketplace. All 14 backend pytest tests passed (auth register/login/me, product CRUD, admin authorization, wallet topup/purchase/transactions/insufficient balance). Full frontend flows verified via Playwright: registration, login, top-up (quick $100 + card method), successful purchase (Pulse Mouse Pro $79 deducted from balance and toast shown), insufficient balance (Neon Console X $499 shows 'Saldo insuficiente' toast with 'Cargar saldo' action), Mi Cuenta shows balance and transactions list, non-admin /admin shows 'Acceso restringido', admin login shows nav-admin, admin product form validates 'Sube una imagen del producto'. Backend and frontend integration solid.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent} (accessibility a11y)

action_items: Optional (a11y): add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside AuthDialog to remove Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Wallet topup/purchase use $inc on balance without a transactional session; on high concurrency two purchases could bypass balance check. For MVP acceptable, but consider Mongo transactions or conditional update ({balance: {$gte: price}}) with matched_count check for safety.
put_object/get_object are synchronous requests calls inside async FastAPI handlers – they block the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool for /api/upload and /api/files/{path}.
/api/files/{path} does not 404 gracefully if storage returns 404 (get_object raises_for_status will 500). Return HTTPException(404) instead.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject. Consider setting explicit origins when using credentials, or set allow_credentials=False since app uses Bearer tokens in localStorage.
verify_password on admin startup is a blocking bcrypt call inside async startup; fine for MVP but blocks event loop briefly.
Admin form: save button is not disabled when image is missing; UX shows an error toast instead. Consider disabling admin-save-btn until image + fields present for better UX (minor).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@inflowmkt.com / InflowAdmin2026 (verified). Test users registered dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 products at startup (Neon Console X, Pulse Mouse Pro, Chrono Watch S) - verified present. Test-created products prefixed with TEST_ are deleted at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header nav testids follow pattern `nav-<label lowercased with '-'>`: nav-inicio, nav-productos, nav-mi-cuenta, nav-cargar-saldo, nav-admin (admin only). Auth trigger is data-testid='header-login-btn'. Auth dialog defaults to LOGIN mode; click auth-toggle-mode to switch to register (adds auth-name-input). Admin panel requires image upload before save (validation toast fires). All flows work end-to-end.
